title: ShaderToy LiveCoding - The Drive Home - 1. Basic Setup
summary: The first part of a ShaderToy live-coding series that lays the groundwork for The Drive Home, a rainy night-traffic shader. It covers basic setup and builds toward rain and bokeh effects.
why: Recommended in shader and rain-simulation threads as an engaging tutorial from a well-liked graphics-programming channel.

quote.text: The accompanying video tutorial[2] is super interesting too
